messages.subject: For Hock Tan | AI infrastructure, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Broadcom Press Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Hock Tan, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Broadcom's growth across AI semiconductors and infrastructure software increasingly intersects with governments, strategic technology policy, major customers and global investment priorities. That environment aligns closely with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and global stakeholder execution might support Broadcom's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Broadcom.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
